acceptance: Each named rewrite has tests on representative queries; execution on duckdb, datafusion (in process), chdb or PySpark where the target dialect has an obtainable engine; others recorded as gaps.
The fork contains no TPC-H query ids or benchmark names; rewrite names are generic.
Output differences versus the BenchBox transformers over their unit-test inputs are listed in the PR.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PRs merged.
description: Expose the pure AST logic of benchbox/core/tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py, cloud_compat.py, core/spark_query_transformer.py and the DataFusion Q11/Q16/Q18/Q20 transformer as named rewrites taking (expression, dialect, **args): inline select aliases, window-filter rewrite, Presto array aggregation, ClickHouse and BigQuery filter rewrites, drop empty grouping, ordered array aggregation, scalar group-by and dual rewrites, postgres column qualification and dual to values. Convert the Snowflake GROUP BY () and BigQuery NULLS LAST text replaces to generator behavior. Variant id sets, qualified-column tables and the variant to rewrite dispatch table stay in BenchBox. Expect two PRs; DataFusion rules are re-implemented as AST rules because they exist only as TPC-H text regexes.
